item.title: on single tasking
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months single tasking bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Single tasking shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: thinking about single tasking
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:

why it matters

Single tasking shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

item.title: the case for single tasking
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months single tasking bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Single tasking shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
